name: Cotton
read: Cotton Jan 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 82.05, 24 days to expiry 2026-12-18): at-the-money implied vol 24.6%, +3.2 pts vs 2026-11-18. 20-day realized vol 19.1%, so options trade at a premium of 5.5 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +0.9 (calls over puts). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-11-11 to 2026-11-24) call open interest fell 103,222 and puts fell 71,050; put/call OI 0.5 → 0.4, front futures 82.39 → 82.05. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +9,046 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 20.1% → 24.6%. Largest Jan 27 strikes: 80 calls (1,461 lots) and 82 puts (2,892). Biggest 5-session builds: May 27 85 calls +6,891; May 27 145 calls +3,994. Biggest cut: May 27 115 calls -2,648.
